node.statement: For each of the four newly constructed raw calls, the preceding conclusions give a finite-dimensional C*-algebra source, the unchanged target corner and amplification family, target ambient defect at most t, an extended D_*t-inclusion, and unit error at most D_*t, with D_*>=1 and 0<=t<=W.r_reset. The chosen c0 satisfies c0>=max{c0^0,K_floor,C_unit*(K_floor+1)}, and the reset-radius inequalities above are exactly those required by lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation with D=D_*. Thus that external applies to each call (preserving bijectivity for u_2 and u_3), so all four satisfy the M02/M03 and near-unit thresholds and are eligible for reset; together with the constructed W and the four map conclusions, this establishes the root claim.
